title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Credit Rate Where the Office Has Already Credited the Owner
content:
## Credit schedule

The rate at which the value of an unperformed visit is credited on a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record steps up with how often the office has already had to credit the owner. The count is of the credits for a visit that went unperformed already standing on the agreement.

| Credits for a visit that went unperformed already standing on the agreement | Rate the value is credited at |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | the repeat lapse rate, 150 percent |
| exactly 1 | the second lapse rate, 125 percent |
| none | the missed visit credit rate the tier publishes |

### Schedule notes

- At a count of exactly 2 the repeat lapse rate of 150 percent applies; at a count of exactly 1 the second lapse rate of 125 percent applies.
- Where no credit of that kind stands on the agreement, the rate is the missed visit credit rate published for the agreement's tier.
- The step turns on the number of such credits standing, not on their amounts.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

On an agreement carrying 1 credit for a visit that went unperformed, a value of 600.00 USD is credited at 125 percent, that is 750.00 USD. On an agreement carrying 3 such credits the same value is credited at 150 percent, that is 900.00 USD.
